title: Normalized derived reduction of abelian towers
statement: For a scheme $T$ and a ring-sheaf tower $B$, use the system and section-normalized forgetful categories of [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. Define reduction data as an ordinary additive left adjoint to this forgetful functor, its universal total left derived functor, and the derived adjunction. On complexes the derived adjunction must transpose its universal counit exactly to the ordinary adjunction, after the canonical localization comparison. Define source normalization by the equality saying that a comparison from the reduced integral unit to the coefficient unit transposes to the canonical integer quotient. Define target normalization for a short exact sequence by the equality saying that its reduced shifted quotient comparison transposes to the positively normalized connecting arrow, with the canonical shift-addition comparison. Define transport of a single-to-shifted-single derived arrow by an exact functor using its canonical single and shift comparisons. For a line bundle [def-sc-invertible-module], its integral class is the frame-torsor Ext class pulled from the etale site by [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], followed by the canonical units comparison, and then made a constant tower. The integer comparison is the comparison of the two constant-sheaf left adjoints. No independent choice of a line-bundle morphism occurs.
